svg.title: Droply market-first foundations and browser flow
svg.desc: An editable modern Android UI board with visual foundations, paste-link home, browser discovery, detected media, and quality selection.
svg.text: Independent concept — fast intent, clear trust, playful confidence. No platform branding or borrowed UI.
